tool.name: List Agents From Marketplace
tool.description: Search and list agent templates available in the marketplace for discovery and deployment. Supports search by name, description, or capabilities. Returns a lean array (id, slug, name, description, category, role) without heavy fields like systemPrompt or blueprint.

query.description: Search query to filter agents by name, description, or capabilities (e.g., "customer support", "coding", "research")

nodes.name: Summarize Templates
nodes.description: Extract and format agent template data
